elements.text:
Exhibition of optical studies,
woven and printed squares
A course in seeing red, yellow and blue.

Saturday 11 to 17
Six rooms, forty makers.
A free map of every route, folded to fit a pocket. Pick one up at the ticket hall.

elements.text: Before you draw, spend ten minutes just looking at the thing.

elements.text: Remove every line that does not carry weight. Then remove one more.
The second version is the one you keep. The first is a sketch.
